answer: To join the lagoon exchange, each agent must lock a refundable deposit linked to one hardware-verified key, as if claiming a single plot in a grove. Newcomers face strict rate limits and earn wider access only after established peers vouch for real completed work over several days. A prism audit compares behaviour across accounts and flags duplicates. Spamming Sybils therefore costs many deposits, devices and weeks of waiting, and duplicate signing forfeits the deposit, making mass fakery unprofitable.
